verdict: The inspected prior operations already establish graph block mixture responsibilities, masked graph/degree training with count-free edge readout, NCNC-informed coupled refinement, and contextual coherent-set single models. The remaining falsifiable distinction is transfer of count-conditioned identity association on the actual native two-side TRAIN residual support into unchanged native served ranking. This is an adaptation hypothesis, not generic novelty clearance.

new_primary_evidence.conclusion: MaskGAE train_step combines masked edge objective with masked degree MSE and backpropagates into encoder; batch_predict/test_step_ogb call encoder plus edge decoder without the degree decoder or counts. OGB source selects paired AUC and a simple random negative sampler; paper BCE is not the only author-source recipe.

GRAN _sampling samples one component for a whole block then Bernoulli edges and uses graph-conditioned outputs. Dataset support and heuristic order bank are ordered graph-generation operations; serving samples graph-node count from empirical PMF, not a native residual identity auxiliary or NCNC ranker.

narrow_falsifiable_claim: Within the declared native TRAIN observation/mask/support contract, sharing component responsibility between the two count-conditioned residual identity subsets can improve an unchanged count-free native link ranker beyond independent-side mixtures; any claimed bank necessity additionally requires a competent, adequately matched structured Single.
falsifiers_and_non_evidence: Conditional proxy NLL improvement without served ranking benefit does not establish useful transfer.
No material J_K over J_K_sep benefit under competent fitting defeats the shared-association utility claim in that recipe.
A qualified competent Single matching the bank defeats bank necessity; a failed, unqualified or order-confounded Single does not establish necessity.
Fixed-parameter whole-side marginals match between J_K and J_K_sep, but separately fitted models need not match learned marginals.
Native TRAIN support opportunities, counts and exact law checks do not establish association strength or predictive utility.

symmetry.bank_fixed_logits_slot_permutation: Exact conditional subset law commutes with consistent slot permutation; native encoder/scorer/masks still need their own graph-relabel qualification.
symmetry.single_storage_permutation: If canonicalization recovers the same node-ID order and first reference, storage permutation can be consistent. This is not arbitrary traversal invariance.
symmetry.single_global_node_relabel: No architectural guarantee; sorted numeric IDs, first-slot reference, progress and selected-prefix history can change the conditional sequence.
symmetry.single_endpoint_exchange: Not guaranteed by original orientation, all-left-before-right sequence and unsymmetrized features.
symmetry.matched_control_implication: The order-dependent Single is a capable normalized fixed-count comparator, but its failure cannot alone support equivariant structural/bank necessity.
